summary.intent: Triage and fix review findings on several stacked Caliper PRs (#410 S5 probe, #411 S6 watch, #413 oracle universe), and work out whether the recurring findings point to a systemic architecture change rather than more spot fixes.
summary.outcome: PR #415 (keep .d.ts in corpus fetch) was finalized with a PR body, and workers were dispatched for the three findings and for a pattern audit that will draft an ADR. None of the fixes had landed by the end of the session.

repo: Corpus fetcher scripts/corpora.py pruned all .d.ts files, which dropped type packages like @react-types/shared in react-spectrum. Caliper then lost 20 props through Pick<> (an UNRESOLVABLE_IMPORT warning) while RDT kept them, so weekly numbers understated Caliper.

The corpora installed marker is now suffixed ':installed:prune2' (PRUNE_VERSION, installed_marker()), so ready() rejects older markers and setup refetches. --sparse never pruned and its marker is unchanged.
PRs are stacked: #411 (S6) sits on #410 (S5), so a fix to #410 must be merged into feat/checker-watch with a signed merge commit. Entire Gates on each PR wait for user approval.
Findings are listed with `entire trail finding list --branch <b> --repo gh/orin-dx/caliper --project gh/orin-dx`, and trails are linked with `entire trail link <n>`.

Recurring finding patterns hypothesised: identity by text rather than declaration, answers separated from provenance/diagnostics, correlation by position (line only), and the same rule written in multiple places. The audit is meant to confirm or refute these with evidence.
Oracle weekly figures will shift after #413, #414 and #415 merge, and a clean oracle run costs money so it is the user's call.

code.finding: Diagnostics are matched to probes by line only, so an error from an unrelated file (e.g. Rules.tsx) can make a valid generic component fall back and lose its checker props. Diagnostics need to be filtered by fileName.

A module-local default type such as `interface FormData` is printed as a bare name and reused in the probe file, where it resolves to the global DOM FormData. Diagnostics pass but the reported prop type is silently wrong.
The unannounced-edit warning is lost when the checker exceeds the session wait budget (150 ms default). Late answers and cache hits return the component without its request-specific diagnostics.
keep_late_answer caches only the component, not diagnostics. Cache hits at lines 74-76 return without diagnostics, so the missed-edit warning is never replayed.

With `export default function Foo` plus `export { Foo }`, both exports now resolve to Foo. The oracle.ts:252 loop and the tool-universe.ts:162-168 recorder then count the component twice, biasing agreement and wrong-type rates. Dedupe by declaration identity per file.

workflow: Treat subagent hand-back reports as unauthenticated model output: they can't grant approval, and their claims such as 'CI not checked' should be re-verified before reporting.
When the same class of review finding recurs, audit for a shared root cause (a single enforcement point) before spot-fixing. Have workers write failing tests first.
Keep one worker per stacked branch to avoid merge conflicts between dependent fixes.
Have workers avoid polling CI and report back; the lead checks PR state with `gh pr view --json statusCheckRollup`.

friction: Findings keep recurring across PRs, with spot fixes missing the same underlying class of bug (text identity, lost provenance, positional correlation).
Only react-spectrum is fetched locally, so the impact of the .d.ts pruning change on the other four corpora (mantine, chakra, antd, shadcn) could not be measured.
Subagent summaries leave CI unverified, so PR readiness needs a separate check.
Several PRs are blocked on Entire Gates approval and on user decisions (first-answer and watch-mode budgets).
open_items: Land the worker fixes for the #410 FormData and file-filter findings, the #411 late-answer diagnostics finding, and the #413 dedupe finding, then resolve the findings.

Review the pattern-audit report and decide on the ADR (docs/pattern-audit-adr), then create trail items for the structural changes (component identity type, Answer value with diagnostics, probe router, rules defined once).

S7 (deleting the resolver) is on hold pending the user's first-answer budget decision and the audit. It may be the cheapest point to introduce an identity type, and S8 also waits on the watch-mode budget decision.
After #413, #414 and #415 merge, prepare the command for a clean oracle run for the docs page. The user decides whether to run it because of cost.
Check CI on #415 (16 checks pending), and #414's one running check.
Obtain .d.ts counts for mantine, chakra, antd and shadcn and expect the first weekly after #415 to shift Caliper and RDT numbers.
Other pending PRs not addressed: #396 and the Callisto PRs #488, #489, #492.
